current.text: He signed a 4-year, 10 million dollar contract with the Knicks.
He has no starting role. The projected Knicks starters are Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
He had a very poor Summer League: 2 points per game, 7% from the field and no made two-pointers.
He is a wing to watch this season who may need to step up for the Knicks.
He is not a draft target in a 12-team league. Both sites value him at 0 USD.

durable.text: The expert sees him as a future starting-caliber wing and still likes him long term. He must be rostered in very deep dynasty leagues.
In his small role he gives very little in points, rebounds and steals, far below the top 250 pool.

note: Diawara is not draftable in our league. Yahoo ranks him 424 and ESPN 338, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he played only 9.2 minutes per game for 3.6 points last season.
